name: Molecular Sequence and Structure Modeling Pipeline Template
summary: Reusable base CDG for molecule, protein, RNA, chemistry, and perturbation tasks that combine tokenization or fingerprints, sequence/graph/3D structure encoders, biological or chemical context, and calibrated scientific objectives.
dejargonized_summary: Represent molecules or biological sequences with tokens, fingerprints, graphs, or 3D coordinates; train sequence, graph, or geometric neural models; add context such as cell type or assay metadata; and calibrate scientific predictions.

inputs.name: molecular_records
inputs.constraints: SMILES, sequence, graph, 3D coordinates, assay metadata, or cell context.

outputs.name: molecular_predictions
outputs.constraints: Predictions for molecular, protein, RNA, or assay targets.

use_when: Inputs are molecules, proteins, RNA, cell perturbations, chemical fingerprints, or 3D molecular structures.
Winning solutions depend on tokenization, fingerprints, graph neural networks, geometric transformers, or assay/cell context.
do_not_use_when: Inputs are ordinary text or tabular records without molecular sequence, graph, or structure semantics.
Molecular metadata is already represented by ordinary handcrafted tabular features and no sequence, graph, structure, assay, or scaffold-aware stage is load-bearing.
applicability.key_insight: The durable topology is molecular representation construction before sequence/graph/geometric modeling and assay-aware calibration.

swappable_stages.sequence_graph_structure_encoder: Can be a transformer, graph neural network, geometric transformer, SchNet-like model, or fingerprint plus tree ensemble.

applicability.scaling_notes: Cache fingerprints, conformers, and graph construction; keep train/test chemistry splits explicit.
failure_modes: Random splits can overestimate performance when scaffolds or assay contexts leak.
Invalid tokenization or conformer generation can silently drop important molecules.

planning_constraints.subject: representation_before_encoder
planning_constraints.statement: Construct molecular tokens, fingerprints, graphs, sequences, or 3D inputs before training sequence, graph, or geometric encoders.
planning_constraints.rationale: The encoder architecture depends on the representation contract and cannot be chosen independently of it.

planning_constraints.subject: scaffold_assay_leakage_guard
planning_constraints.statement: Preserve scaffold, assay, organism, cell type, or target grouping when calibrating and validating scientific predictions.
planning_constraints.rationale: Random splits can leak near-duplicate chemistry or assay context and inflate molecular benchmark estimates.

audit.rationale: Added after expansion validation left repeated unmatched molecular, RNA, protein, chemistry, and cell perturbation solutions where representation construction and scientific objectives define a distinct topology.
audit.dejargonized_summary: This captures tasks where molecular or biological structure must be represented before sequence, graph, geometric, or assay-aware modeling.
uncertainty_notes: Future ingestion should decide which chemistry feature generators are base-stage refinements versus new atoms.

references.title: Sciona expansion support-3 validation audit
references.note: Local deterministic and semantic audit of unmatched solution patterns.

stages.name: Molecular Representation
stages.description: Create SMILES tokens, BPE tokens, RDKit/ECFP fingerprints, sequence features, graph edges, or 3D coordinate inputs.
stages.dejargonized_description: Convert molecular or biological records into model-ready sequence, fingerprint, graph, or geometry representations.

outputs.name: molecular_features
outputs.constraints: Token, graph, fingerprint, or geometry features.

preconditions: Molecular strings, sequences, or structures are parseable.
guarantees: Features preserve molecular identity and assay metadata.

stages.name: Context Conditioning
stages.description: Attach assay, cell type, organism, scaffold, target, or experimental context embeddings.
stages.dejargonized_description: Add biological or chemical context that changes target behavior.
preconditions: Context metadata is aligned to records.
guarantees: Context is available to downstream models.

stages.name: Sequence Graph Structure Encoder
stages.description: Train a transformer, graph neural network, geometric transformer, SchNet-like model, or fingerprint-based ensemble over molecular features.
stages.dejargonized_description: Model sequence, graph, or 3D structure interactions.

stages.name: Scientific Objective
stages.description: Train with assay-specific classification, regression, ranking, stability, binding, or perturbation objectives.
stages.dejargonized_description: Optimize the loss that matches the scientific target.
preconditions: Target type and metric are known.

stages.name: Scaffold and Assay Calibration
stages.description: Apply scaffold-aware validation, assay-specific calibration, uncertainty aggregation, or thresholding.
stages.dejargonized_description: Calibrate predictions while respecting chemical or assay groups.
preconditions: Groups, scaffolds, or assay context are known if needed.
guarantees: Outputs are calibrated for the benchmark metric.
